readings.Aries: Something you dismissed as beneath you is exactly where the answer is. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.
readings.Taurus: Your relationship with pleasure is complicated in a way that has nothing to do with pleasure. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Gemini: Your wit is a gift. It's also where you go when you don't want to be known. Make contact with the actual person rather than the version in your head.
readings.Cancer: Someone needs your care. You need rest. Both things are true simultaneously. Something is about to become obvious.
readings.Leo: What you love, you love completely. This is both your most beautiful quality and your most difficult one. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Virgo: There is a small pleasure available to you right now that your efficiency has been routing around. Take it. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Libra: Your instinct for what looks and feels right is calibrated finely. Trust it on the bigger questions too. This situation responds well to direct engagement.
readings.Scorpio: You know something about someone that they don't know you know. Decide what to do with it carefully. Someone you haven't thought of lately is relevant to this.
readings.Sagittarius: You are better at starting than finishing. This particular thing deserves to be finished. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Capricorn: Your work ethic is not in question. Your relationship to rest is the variable. The timing is better than it feels.
readings.Aquarius: There's loneliness in always being slightly ahead. Acknowledge it. It doesn't make you less visionary. The timing is better than it feels.
readings.Pisces: Something that feels like confusion is actually the process of integrating two incompatible things. Let it process. Say the thing you've been rehearsing.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
